description: Issue #54: a path cited under 根拠 / 参考 is evidence, not a target. #50 gave an issue a way to say "this path IS my product" but no way to say the opposite, so a bug report that cited the file it reproduces in — the normal way to write one — handed the worker write permission on a file the body explicitly says is not changed. Only web/src/lib/filter.ts, written under 成果物, becomes scope.allow; store.ts and old-filter.ts are read-only context. A green run with three suspected_files here would be the bug.
